  N_total                    400
  N_with_point_cloud         400
  N_with_GT_step             400
  N_with_GT_mesh             0
  N_MIRAGE_prediction        400
  N_CADRecode_prediction     0
  N_MIRAGE_valid_mesh        0
  N_CADRecode_valid_mesh     0
  N_paired_valid_mesh        0
  N_CD_eligible              0
  N_IoU_eligible             0

  the two accountings this manifest exists to keep separate:
    unconditional denominator   400  (every common input id; a failure to produce geometry is a system failure, not a missing datum)
    paired-valid denominator    0  (the only rows on which CD and IoU can be compared at all)

  missing artefacts, which are the work list rather than errors:
    gt_mesh_not_tessellated    400

  No ground-truth meshes exist yet, so per-sample CD floors could not be
  computed. The STEP sources are present; tessellating them is the next step,
  and its tolerance is a protocol parameter because the same meshes feed BOTH
  the metric and CAD-Recode's own input pipeline.
